query_command: SELECT [System.Id], [System.WorkItemType], [System.Title], [System.AssignedTo], [System.State], [System.Tags], [System.CreatedDate], [System.ChangedDate] FROM workitems WHERE [System.WorkItemType] IN ('需求','Bug') AND [System.AssignedTo] = @me AND [System.State] <> '已验证' AND [System.State] <> '已关闭' ORDER BY [System.Id]
